title: Kinetic type promo (9:16)
description: A 10-second vertical kinetic-typography promo in the style of studio motion-design reels: four phrases rise word by word, an accent circle lands as each full stop and swells into the next phrase's ground, over a drifting dot grid, with a procedural pulse bed and a whoosh on every wipe. Code-rendered (scene.kinetic-type), so it renders with no footage, models or downloads.

hook.description: Opening phrase that stops the scroll, 2-5 words

payoff.description: Closing phrase or brand line, 2-5 words; its last word is set in the accent colour

look.description: Visual look: swiss (off-white, black, orange), neon (black, white, acid green), ink (dark, cream, orange), calm (pale, navy, blue)

energy.description: Music energy for the procedural bed

scene.description: The kinetic type animation; rendered from the phrases unless supplied

music.description: Music bed; produced procedurally unless a cleared track is supplied

copy_examples.brief: Vertical promo for Fieldnotes, a notes app for field biologists that works offline and syncs when you are back in range. Close on the name.

inputs.point_2: Synced the moment you are back

copy_examples.note: Each phrase is one beat a viewer reads in two seconds: the hook names the pain, two phrases give the two facts from the brief, and the payoff lands on the audience. No phrase repeats another.

style.typography: Inter Black, left aligned, word-by-word masked rises

direction.action: Four phrases, one per beat; the accent circle is the full stop and the cut

notes: The animation is code (recipes/scene/kinetic-type) rendered frame-exactly on a virtual clock; the content model supplies only four phrases and two choices.
Phrases are auto-fitted with measured glyphs; each is capped at 48 characters by the recipe schema.
Whoosh cues sit on the circle wipes at 2.05 s, 4.55 s and 7.05 s, which the recipe derives from the 10-second duration and four phrases.

quality_gates.description: Integrated loudness lands within 1 LU of the -14 LUFS delivery target.
Decoded true peak stays at or below -0.5 dBTP after AAC encoding.
No stretch of blank picture (no visible contrast, any colour) lasts longer than 0.5 seconds.
A reviewer confirms every phrase is accurate and approved for the brand.
